text:
Which statement about the life cycle of a star is correct?
A
All stars eventually run out of hydrogen as fuel.
B
A red giant forms a planetary nebula with a supernova at its centre.
C
A white dwarf star eventually forms a black hole.
D
Most stars expand and form protostars.

options.label: A
options.text: All stars eventually run out of hydrogen as fuel.

options.label: B
options.text: A red giant forms a planetary nebula with a supernova at its centre.

options.label: C
options.text: A white dwarf star eventually forms a black hole.

options.label: D
options.text: Most stars expand and form protostars.
